Auburn University at Montgomery was established in 1967 in Montgomery, Alabama. A campus university offering over 100 degrees in a variety of popular subjects, it has one of the most diverse campuses in the southeast of America and offers numerous scholarships to aspiring students. This makes the employability of graduates high as they enter the workforce.

Every year, around 2,500 international students enrol at the top ranked university in Alabama. In the 2023 World & News Report, the university was rated as offering the best online masterâ€™s in business programs and the best online bachelorâ€™s programs.

Auburn University at Montgomery (AUM) offers facilities that cater to the diverse needs of its student body. The campus is equipped with modern academic buildings featuring well-equipped classrooms, cutting-edge laboratories, and collaborative study spaces that facilitate an enriching learning environment. AUM's fitness center offers top-notch athletic facilities, including a well-equipped gym, indoor track, and recreational courts for sports enthusiasts. Additionally, the university provides a range of dining options for all dietary preferences.

Student Life

The numerous student clubs at Auburn University at Montgomery range from special interest societies like Adventures in Anime to religious groups such as The Bridge. Politically minded students can get involved with student government while those looking for recreational opportunities can watch theatre productions on campus. The campus has large amounts of green space and is easy to navigate.
